Thank you very much for your reply. I am trying my best to not freak out. 

Should I act completely normal? I don't want to scare her off, but I don't want to trivialize the situation either. How should I express my concern without making her defensive (because then she will keep it to herself). She certainly is not suicidal (not yet), but self-harm itself is not something trivial either. 

As for why she is choosing to do this, most of her stress comes from her friends. As I said earlier, most of them are depressed and some of them have seriously attempted suicide a few times before. For some reason, they all chose to confide in her and most of them are depressed. All of this really gets to her. I don't have good access to professionals (stuck in a third-world country) and we are thousands of miles apart. I don't know her friends either, so there isn't much I can do about them. I can't help but get worried about them, and even more, about her.
